title: Wavefunctions localization, and the Wigner's Friend Paradox in a Framework of Discrete-Space Hypothesis
summary: We present a resolution of the Wigner's Friend paradox within a framework of quantum mechanics (QM) on the hybrid space RxQ_{p}, where Q_{p} denotes the field of p-adic numbers, regarded as a model of discrete microscopic space at the Planck-Bronstein scale. In this framework, wavefunction collapse is not an independent postulate but a dynamical consequence of the Schrödinger equation with non-local Hamiltonians: wavefunctions localize onto compact supports during measurement interactions, producing definite pointer readings without the intervention of observers or the exchange of…
